ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer Quest Faction Fix
ModMetaData.author: Angela Fisher
ModMetaData.description: Fixes quest map/faction context in Multiplayer so guest join offers and recruitment use the target colony instead of Spectator. Routes private quest failures to the owning colony and shared participants. Public and multi-colony quest notifications reach all relevant colonies. Automatically hides quests belonging to another player faction; public quests remain visible. Load after Multiplayer and Multiplayer Compatibility. All players must install the same version.
